summary: Dowry death conviction under IPC s.304B; cruelty/harassment for dowry demand unproven; prosecution witnesses' testimony inconsistent; omissions in FIR/complaint regarding dowry demand; letters not authenticated; no specific instances of cruelty; conviction set aside due to lack of legally admissible evidence; acquittal granted.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court and Sessions Court judgments quashed; appellants acquitted; bail bonds cancelled.
